# 研究报告

比较 PostgreSQL 17 与 MySQL 8.4 的 JSON 索引类型、可加速的查询运算符和索引代价，引用官方文档。

**结果：** `COMPLETED_WITH_LIMITATIONS`

## 结论汇总

| 研究对象 | JSON 索引类型 | 可加速的查询运算符 | 索引代价 |
|---|---|---|---|
| PostgreSQL 17 | Of the two operator classes for type `jsonb`, `jsonb_ops` is the default. | Of the two operator classes for type `jsonb`, `jsonb_ops` is the default. `jsonb… | If no operator class is specified, PostgreSQL defaults to `jsonb_ops`. While ver… |
| MySQL 8.4 | 未找到证据 | 未找到证据 | ly difference being that there may be more than one insert or update for a singl… |

## 已验证结论

### ly difference being that there may be more than one insert or update for a single clustered index record.

- 研究项：`MySQL 8.4 · 索引代价`
- 候选：`73a26021-87d5-4458-9401-facfa625b755`
- Evidence: `evidence:45bfc915a892b362e9f328222f3ebd1c069b368f0c7481c4`
  - Exact quote: “ly difference being that there may be more than one insert or update for a single clustered index record.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/112cb147-419f-46e9-b438-563449f442af/1961f1b24ba58ce5147e59702301fb0aae1d7d773e74c90d53289c274eaac9b9`
  - URL: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/9.3/en/create-index.html

### Of the two operator classes for type \`jsonb\`, \`jsonb_ops\` is the default. \`jsonb_path_ops\` supports fewer operators but offers better performance for those operators.

- 研究项：`PostgreSQL 17 · 可加速的查询运算符`
- 候选：`3014c0ab-fb52-4ead-aaa1-0235de07753d`
- Evidence: `evidence:90bdaa1d1e5745aa49a1975103b0ae634389476a1a199c29`
  - Exact quote: “Of the two operator classes for type \`jsonb\`, \`jsonb_ops\` is the default. \`jsonb_path_ops\` supports fewer operators but offers better performance for those operators.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/ba7f98a9-108c-40db-b5c7-9fec4f32681f/c2a8fc7414fe0686880eeab2eaebe341c08270bbc5075aa4a8203aa50742f415`
  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/gin.html

### If no operator class is specified, PostgreSQL defaults to \`jsonb_ops\`. While versatile, \`jsonb_ops\` always leads to larger indexes.

- 研究项：`PostgreSQL 17 · 索引代价`
- 候选：`976e29ad-1dca-4878-ae88-3d679b6e98d7`
- Evidence: `evidence:bdfdee0e34e05ba7d9eeea85c104efcf44795ec843676be7`
  - Exact quote: “If no operator class is specified, PostgreSQL defaults to \`jsonb_ops\`. While versatile, \`jsonb_ops\` always leads to larger indexes.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/ba7f98a9-108c-40db-b5c7-9fec4f32681f/f8133fb390224a31f88ffe8c4aa45fcf76d548d1cd8ca1b8ec5d437f7a56ce1d`
  - URL: https://medium.com/@josef.machytka/postgresql-jsonb-operator-classes-of-gin-indexes-and-their-usage-0bf399073a4c

### Of the two operator classes for type \`jsonb\`, \`jsonb_ops\` is the default.

- 研究项：`PostgreSQL 17 · JSON 索引类型`
- 候选：`21966710-410f-47a1-ba12-7d432b25c93f`
- Evidence: `evidence:f725c05923e936eb6c3bc75a931cef42a5d3820b79884fb3`
  - Exact quote: “Of the two operator classes for type \`jsonb\`, \`jsonb_ops\` is the default.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/ba7f98a9-108c-40db-b5c7-9fec4f32681f/c2a8fc7414fe0686880eeab2eaebe341c08270bbc5075aa4a8203aa50742f415`
  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/gin.html

## 局限与未解决项

- **MySQL 8.4 · 可加速的查询运算符**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- **MySQL 8.4 · JSON 索引类型**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- REQUIRED_CELLS_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED
- UNRESOLVED_CELLS_REMAIN

## 完成判定原因

- REQUIRED_CELLS_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED
- UNRESOLVED_CELLS_REMAIN
